Title: [Enterprise Plan] Direct upload from CLO Software
Content: Objective For Enterprise plan users, You can directly upload a 3D project file including or excluding garment/avatar from CLO Software to CLO-SET and easily share it with other users. Set Preference in CLO3D Direct upload from CLO3D to CLO-SET Details 1) Set preference in CLO3D 1. Sign in to CLO 2. Main Menu Settings User Settings CLOSET 3. Enter and modify your exclusive CLO-SET URL. 2) Direct upload from CLO3D to CLO-SET Main Menu File Share via CLOSET Project/Garment/Avatar Main Menu Project/Garment/Avatar 1. You will be directed to the upload page in CLO-SET. * If you are not a registered user of CLO-SET, you are directed to the sign up page. 2. Select desired Workroom or Style that you'd like to upload or upgrade the 3D file. 3. Click 'Next' button and the file will start uploading.

Title: Content Type & ID
Content: Objective Any 3D/2D/other files uploaded on CLO-SET is designated as a Content. For each Content, you may identify the Content Type to be used throughout CLO-SET, including Tech Pack and Line Sheet. You may also search for relevant Content Type &amp ID by using General Search Function. Content Type Content ID Content Type in Web Tech Pack (BOM) Details 1) Content Type Every Content is classified as a single Content Type in CLO-SET. At the time of upload, you may select the Content Type. Or, for specific file formats, CLO-SET will automatically assign a Content Type. *Any zprj/zpac files uploaded will automatically be identified as a Style Content Type. 2) Content ID Content ID is a unique ID auto-assigned by CLO-SET upon file upload. Content created on or after April 9th, 2024 Content ID is made up of 6 digit number. Each Group will have Content IDs starting from 000001. Content created before April 9th, 2024 Content ID is made up of 3 letter Prefix (Content Type) + 6 digit number. Each Group will have Content IDs starting from 000001. Prefix List: 3) Content Type in Web Tech Pack (BOM) You may add Fabric/Graphic/Trim information on Web Tech Pack - BOM tab. Please note that the file format needs to match the Content Type to be added on BOM.

Title: Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload)
Content: Permission(in CLO-SET Group): Admin, Collaborator, Editor, Viewer with Upload Objective You can directly upload a 3D project file including or excluding garment/avatar from CLO Software to CLO-SET. You may also easily run Render or generate Excel Tech Pack via CLO-SET. Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload) Render via CLO-SET Tech Pack via CLO-SET Details 1) Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload) 1. 'Share via CLO-SET' from CLO Software. Option 1 Option 2 File &gt Share via CLO-SET Main Menu 2. Once your file is ready to upload, click 'OK'. If you are not signed into CLO-SET yet, you will be directed to Sign In page. 3. Choose the Group/Location in which you want to upload the file, or select an existing file in CLO-SET for a version update. 1) Select the Group you want to upload the file to 2) You may choose whether or not you want to notify collaborators in your Group. You may also choose to apply Auto Numbering for CLO-SET to automatically name the content. 3) Upload a new content to an existing Workroom. Click '+MORE' to view the full list. User must have an upload permission to select Workroom. (permissions: Admin, Collaborator, Editor, or Viewer with Upload) Click '+MORE' to view the 'Browse' tab. Only the Spaces to which you have upload permission will be displayed. 4) Version update an existing content. Select an existing content from your CLO-SET space, and upload the file as a newer version (ex. version 2) instead of a separate content. 4. Final view in CLO-SET For Project/Garment/Avatar upload, you will see the 3D viewer in CLO-SET 2) Render via CLO-SET For Render via CLO-SET, once the file is uploaded, Render will start automatically. Learn more about CLO-SET Render HERE. *Rendering will be done per your Render Settings in CLO 3) Tech Pack via CLO-SET For Tech Pack via CLO-SET, once the file is uploaded, Excel Tech Pack will be downloaded automatically. Learn more about Excel Tech Packs HERE. For more information on how to link your CLO-SET account in CLO, click HERE.

Title: Linked Contents (Parent-Child Contents)
Content: Permission: ALL (applicable to all Contents you have download/upload access to) Plan Type: ALL (Enterprise, Advanced, Trial) Objective With this update, you can now link the Contents when uploading new files from CLO. Create the Parent-Child relationship between old and new seasons OR between block files and final output to better track and manage your assets. How To Requirements Details 1) How To To use this feature, you must first setup CLO-SET Library in CLO 3D. Find instructions HERE. First, download a file from your CLO-SET Library in CLO. When setting up the Link between Contents, this original file will work as the 'Parent Content' Make design edits in CLO3D (ex. create a new Colorway or change fabric/material used) Once the design edit is complete, upload it as a new Content with 'Upload to CLO-SET' option. You can also select Render/Tech Pack via CLO-SET. Please note that 'Linked Contents' feature is not compatible when uploading a new Version. Turn on the 'Linked Content' option to create the Parent-Child relationship. Select the Group to upload the new Content. Please note that Contents in different Groups can not be 'Linked' as a Parent-Child. Turn on 'Linked Content' button. Select the Workroom to upload the new Content. Selecting an existing Content is disabled when the 'Linked Content' option is on. Once uploaded, you can click on 'Linked Contents' to view the Parent/Child Contents. in Content Page From 'Child Content' From 'Parent Content' 2) Requirements 1. Rules for identifying 'Original Content' The 'Original Content' is always the first file you open in CLO3D. If you used multiple files from CLO-SET Library to create the new Content, only the very first file added would be linked as the Original Content. If you started with a non-CLO-SET file and added files from CLO-SET library, the latter would not be linked as the Original Content. 2. Rules for Parent-Child relationship Both of the Parent &amp Child Contents MUST be in the same CLO-SET Group to utilize the 'Linked Content' feature.

Title: Render Preset
Content: Render Preset option allows you to provide a uniform Render Setting as a guideline throughout the Company. Permission (Add/Change/Delete): Company Admin Permission (Use): Admin, Collaborator, Editor Plan Type: Advanced, Trial *See below for permission details Objective Save as ZVRP from CLO3D Add/Change/Delete Render Preset Using Render Preset Render Preset - Properties Details 1) Save as ZVRP from CLO3D To start using the new Render Preset feature in CLO-SET, you will need a ZVRP file. On CLO3D software, change Render settings you'd like to save using Property Editor (Image/Video, Light, and Render) Once you are done, click Save As &gt Render Properties to save as ZVRP file. The saved ZVRP includes Image/Video, Camera, Light, and Render properties. Scroll down to #4 for the detailed list of properties to be reflected on CLO-SET Render. A few requirements for CLO-SET: Image count for Turntable must be less than 64 Image size must be less than 5,000px Animation type can not be rendered *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer. 2)Add/Change/Delete Render Preset Company Admin ONLY - Managing the Render Preset for each Company can only be done by the Company Admin. If you are a Collaborator or below, please contact your Admin for support. Click on your Company &gt 'Settings' &gt 'Rendering' to Add/Edit/Delete Render Preset. Click on 'Upload File' to add a Render Preset. You may add up to 32 files. Click on 'Change File' to upload a new ZVRP file. This will NOT affect the previous Render output. The new setting will be used for future Render works. Click 'Download' to save the ZVRP file. Click on the 𝒊 icon to view the property details. Click on X to delete the Render Preset. 3) Using Render Preset Editors or above can utilize the Render Preset for each Content. On your Content Page, click on Render to select the Render Settings. On the drop-down menu, you will see the Company Preset (with icon) Users may save a Preset for themselves. In this case, the individual user's Preset will be shown at the bottom of the drop-down menu. Once you select the Company's Render Preset option, you can not change the Render Settings. You may check the Property details by clicking on the 𝒊 icon. 4) Render Preset - Properties Please find the full list of Render Property to be reflected on CLO-SET Render. <table style="width: 705.594px border-collapse: collapse " border="1"> Image/Video Property Image Type (image/ turntable) Colorway View Point Image Format Image Size Unit (px/in/mm/cm) Resolution Color Texture Crop For Turntable Image Image Count Rotation Angle Rotation Axis Direction Save Video Total Duration Frame Duration Video Format Light Property Preset Rectangle Light Sphere Light Directional Light Spot Light IES Light Dome Light Render Property Noise Threshold Seam Puckering Intensity Light Material Linear Workflow Color Mapping Type Burn Value A few requirements for CLO-SET: Image count for Turntable must be less than 64 Image size must be less than 5,000px Animation type can not be rendered *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer.

Title: Simple Mix & Match
Content: Objective CLO-SET Simple Mix &amp Match is a feature that allows you to play around with your garments by coordinating them as a top and a bottom. You can easily Mix &amp Match' 3D items in real-time. Communicate with your partners, Share ideas, and Make final decisions for your outfits. How to use Mix &amp Match Tips Details 1) How to use Mix&ampMatch 1. Move the Content you want to Mix&ampMatch to the same Assortment room *You can only select the 3D Contents in the same Assortment room from where you entered the Mix&ampMatch page. 2. Multi-select the contents by clicking the check box at the top-left side of the respective content 3. Click the MIX AND MATCH Icon 4. Select the Category (Top/Bottom) 5. Load your items by drag-and-dropping one content from each category(Top/Bottom) into the viewer. 2) Tips We recommend using contents that are created with consistent avatars and poses for more promising outcomes. There is no limitation in categorization. Hence, you may categorize a coat as a Top and a dress as a Bottom to try Mix &amp Match.

Title: Company Setting
Content: Permission: Group Admin, Company Admin Plan Type: Advanced, Trial, Free Objective Company Admin can manage/set Companys space and customize fields within Company Setting. There are 9 tabs in Company Setting - we will break it down to 5 in terms of usage. General Category / Workflow Rendering Status / Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type Trash / Restore Details 1. General General tab is where you can manage basic profile info and operation of the Company. Change Company name Company Library - a unique Workroom where you can store commonly used Assets throughout the Company Line - an optional Space level between Brand and Season 2D Viewer Mode - an option to view your Assets in 2D first, to increase loading speed Accessible People - you may view the full list of users with access on each Space/Content 2. Category / Workflow Category/Workflow are customizable fields, used to identify/search/filter the Content. Category: can add custom Category up to 4th depth Workflow: can add custom Workflow stage, change name and color chips Utilizing Category &amp Workflow Identify the status of each Content Filter or Search the Content using Category &amp Workflow Quickly view the workflow status from Workroom 3. Rendering Add a Render Preset to share throughout the Company as a guideline. In Company Settings, you can Add/Change/Delete the Preset file (ZVRP) for your Company. Click on the link to find out more. 4. Status / Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type Customizable Fields are available for use on Line Sheet - List Mode to detail each Colorway. Add new fields for your Company, and start utilizing them on Line Sheet. Status: Add custom fields to identify the status for each Colorway Workflow can be set on Content level, and Status can be changed per Colorway on Line Sheet Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type: Add custom fields to use on Line Sheet 5. Trash / Restore Deleted Contents/Workroom/Brand is stored for 30 days on the Trash tab. Company Admin may restore the files by selecting them and clicking on RESTORE button.

Title: Excel Download
Content: Objective <table style="border-collapse: collapse height: 45px width: 100%"> You can generate and download an Excel LineSheet that contains information on Colorway, and description of each Content. What is Excel Download? How to Excel Download Example Details 1) What is Excel Download? Generate and download Excel Line Sheet from CLO-SET. Excel Downloads contain Style number, description, modification date and name, and tags. 2) How To use Excel Download Excel Download is available at Workroom &amp Assortment level Manually select the contents you wish to include (Single or Multi-select) Hover over the content you wish to select, and click on the blank square on the top left corner. Once you are done selecting, click 'Excel Download' to download the Excel file. Download Excel including all contents in your space by clicking 'Excel Download All Contents' In your Workroom/Assortment, click 'Excel Download All Contents'. 3) Excel Download Example Informations Included are: All Excel Download files: Company / Brand / Line / Season / Workroom / zfab / zpac / etc: Style Number / Description / Modified date and name / Creator / Description / Colorway zfab: from CLO-SET: Content Name / Description / Modified Date / Modified By / Created By / Tags from CLO3D: Name / Item No. / Construction / Composition / Supplier / Owner / Colorway

Title: Create Space
Content: Objective CLO-SET provides a tailored Space structure tailored for Fashion industry. Start adding new Spaces to build a unique structure that meets your Company's needs. CLO-SET Space Hierarchy Creating each Space Details 1) CLO-SET Space Hierarchy CLO-SET Group consists of Spaces from Company all the way to Workroom &amp Assortment. Workroom is where you can directly upload your Contents and Assets. You may also manage permission by Space. Learn more HERE. 2) Creating each Space Creating Company Go to 'Companies' and click icon to create the Company. You can select the Company picture, color and name. Click 'Confirm' to create the Company. Creating Brand Go to 'Brands' and click icon to create the Brand. You can select the Brand picture, color and name. Click 'Confirm' to create the Brand. Creating Season Once you enter into the specific Brand page, click icon to create the Season. You can type the name of the Season and click 'Confirm' to create the Season. Creating Workroom/Assortment Once you enter into the specific Season page, click icon to create the Workroom or Assortment. You can type the name of the Workroom/Assortment and click 'Confirm' to create the Space. Creating Sub-workroom You can create multiple sub-workrooms under Workroom. Once you enter into the specific Workroom page, click icon and click 'Confirm' to create the sub-workroom.

Title: Virtual Fitting - Avatar Option
Content: Objective Virtual Fitting supports multiple Skin Types for CLO Avatars, as well as Custom Avatars. Preset Avatar Custom Avatar Preparing Custom Avatar Download Sample Mannequin from CONNECT Fitting Viewer Details 1)Preset Avatar From the Assortment, you now have an option to choose the Skin Type of CLO Avatars. Select the Skin Type to run the Fitting Conversion. Once the Conversion is done, launch the Fitting Viewer. Within the Fitting Viewer, you will have an option to select the Avatar's Skin Type. 2) Custom Avatar You can now upload your own Avatar to be used for Fitting Conversion. Upload an Avatar(.avt) file in your Workroom.Select the Content Type as 'Avatar'. As long as the .avt file is uploaded within your Group, you will be able to use it in any Assortment Room. If your file is compatible to run the Fitting Conversion, your Avatar will be added under the CUSTOM tab. How do I make my avatar compatible? Select the Avatar to run the Fitting Conversion. Once the Conversion is done, launch the Fitting Viewer Within the Fitting Viewer, you will have an option to select the Custom Avatar. *Preparing Custom Avatar To use a Custom Avatar for CLO-SET Fitting, you need to prepare your Custom Avatar to be compatible with the Fitting Conversion. You may do so by using CLO3D's Auto Converting feature. 1.Have your Custom Avatar file (.avt) ready. 2. In CLO3D software, Click on [Main Menu Avatar Auto Convert to Avatar] 3. Upload the .avt file (in A Pose only), and select below options. Then, Convert to a new .avt file. Upload .avt file in A Pose Select Gender Select 'Automatic' converting option Check 'Size Editable' Click Convert A new file will be generated/saved 4. Save the new .avt file 5. Upload the new .avt file in CLO-SET Workroom 6. Go to Assortment, select the Content, and click Fitting. On the 'CUSTOM' tab, you will see your custom avatar option. *If you do not have a custom avatar file, you may try using the Mannequins provided on the CONNECT channel. Male Mannequin / Female Mannequin *If your Avatar file does not show on CUSTOM tab, please reach out to hello@clo-set.com 3) Fitting Viewer New! CLO-SET Fitting Viewer. Visit Virtual Fitting article to find out more. If you want to add new Avatars, simply run Fitting Conversion on the same Content, with new Avatars. The existing Avatars on the Content will remain, stacking up the new ones. If you want to delete the Avatar option, please delete the Content from your Workroom, upload again, move to Assortment, and run Fitting Conversion using the new Content.

Title: Invite/Share
Content: Invite your team members, or share your work to your partners. Understand the difference and learn how to start collaborating. Objective Invite vs. Share Invite Share Accessible People Public Content Permission Management Details 1) Invite vs. Share There are 4 Permission Level in CLO-SET. You may either Invite your teammates as Admin or Collaborator, or Share your work to Editors or Viewers. Learn more on CLO-SET Permission HERE. Invite Admin or Collaborators Share to Editor or Viewers Add Group Operator 2) Invite to Company / Brand Company Admin has the authority to invite specific users to Company. Company and Brand Admin have the authority to invite specific users to Brand. 1. Enter the email address of the user you wish to invite 2. Select permission (Admin/Collaborator) 3. Click 'Invite' *[Changes on Invite] From May 2024 Prior to May 2024 Recipient is added to the Group and granted access automatically, and do NOT need to accept the invite. Recipient must first accept the invite to access the Space. 3) Share Share Workroom / Assortment / Content Editors or above can share Workroom/Assortment/Content with others. From Content page, click on 'Share' tab on your far right. From Workroom/Assortment, use the right pane. 1. Enter the email address of the user you wish to invite 2. Select permission (Can Edit/Can View) 3. (optional) For Viewers, you may add download/upload permission 4. Click 'Share' *Please be cautious when sharing your Content. 4) Accessible People At the bottom of the Share Tab, you may view the full list of Accessible People to each Space/Content. This includes not only the people shown on the above list, but all users who with access. *For example, from Workroom, you can only invite Editor/Viewers, but anyone with Admin/Collaborator permission on the upper level Spaces can also access the Workroom. 5) Public Content You may publicize your Content to share with a broader audience. There are 2 options: 1. Embed the 3D Viewer to your own website - NO CLO-SET account required to view 2. Share with Link - Anyone with the link can view -please be cautious as this will make your Workroom/Content Public. That is, anyone with the link can view your Content, and share it with others without a limit. 6) Permission Management for Group Admin / Group Operator To view the full list of Group members and manage Permission, visit 'Permission Management' from the Console tab. Find out more details on Permission Management HERE.

Title: Content Copy
Content: Objective You can copy a Content to a different Workroom, or within the same Workroom. When Contents are copied, it will bring with it all of the details within. Content Copy Copy as Linked Content Details 1) Content Copy Enter the Workroom in which the desired Content is located. Select the Content Select 'Copy' from the floating menu Enter the name of the Copy Select Copy Type, and select the Workroom to generate the Copy in To make it a Linked Content, turn on the option 2)Copy as Linked Content Turn on 'Make a Child Content' option Enter a Memo about the Child Content, and click 'OK' Your will see a Child Content has been created at the selected Workroom From the Parent Content, click on the 'Linked Content' button to view the full list. *When you create a copy within the same Company space as the original file, Workflow &amp Category information will be copied as well. If not, it will be reset. *When you multi-copy and create Child Content, each copy will be linked to the same garment only. For example, if you select garment A,B,C and copy them with Child Content option, garment A will be linked to the copy of garment A only.

Title: Group
Content: Objective Understand the CLO-SET Group structure. Understanding the Group structure and operation is an initial step in collaborating with your team using CLO-SET. What is a 'Group'? Pricing Plan Group Hierarchy Permission Company Transfer Leave a Group Details 1) What is a Group? When a new user signs up in CLO-SET, a new Group is created. Group is the highest level Space in CLO-SET, and within each Group are Spaces such as Company - Brnad - Line - Season etc. You may invite other teammates to your Group, or be invited to another user's Group for collaboration. CLO-SET operates on a Group level. That is, Structure, Permission, and Pricing Plan is determined per Group. 2) Pricing Plan CLO-SET Pricing Plan is applied to each Group. You may check which Plan the Group is using on your dashboard. Please check out our Pricing Page to learn about different options. 3) Group Hierarchy CLO-SET Group consists of different Spaces in a hierarchy. Within each Group can be multiple Company, Brand, Line, Season, Workroom, and Assortment Spaces. You may invite or share each Space with your teammates. Learn more about creating Spaces here. 4) Permission CLO-SET has a total of 5 Permission levels to provide for advanced security control options on your assets. Please check out this article to see different types of Permissions. Permission is also applicable to each Group. For example, you may be a Company Admin within 1 Group, but a Viewer on another Group. 5) Company Transfer Permission: Group Admin / Company Admin Company Transfer allows users to transfer Company between different Groups. This can be an alternative option when your Group Admin changed and you need to change the Group Admin to a different account. 1. Go to 'Company Setting'. 2. Click 'Company Transfer' and enter the Admin email of the recipient Group. 3. Admin of the recipient Group must accept the request to complete the transfer. Log in to CLO-SET to accept. Please be noted that the RECIPIENT of the Company must be on Advanced Plan. 6) Leave a Group Permission: Company Admin / Collaborator / Editor / Viewer / Group Operator Members of the Group can choose to leave a Group without further actions from Admin. Select the Group from the drop-down menu at the top left corner. Go to 'Workspace' or 'Console' tab on the left. (Menu options may differ based on your permission) Click 'Leave This Group' at the bottom. Confirm the action by clicking 'OK'. Make sure to check the name of the Group you are leaving. Upon leaving the Group, Group Admin and Group Operator will receive notifications. *Group Admin cannot leave the Group. *Once you click 'OK', you may NOT undo the action. Please reach out to Group Admin to regain access.
